adjudication_notes.resolution: Keep the first actually failing positive assertion of the archived Tree/Meta verifier. It compiles a schema with recursive children-items anyOf and a structured property reference, then tests jointly valid data. Both reviewers locate real earlier recursive and property-reference executions.

The selected operation includes schema compilation and allows; the schema is an input to that operation. Its new placement of the recursive/null union and structured property reference is classified as Trigger. Treating the schema as Context for allows alone changes the operation boundary, not the historical evidence.

The full expected true relation for newly composed schema/data requires deriving joint validity. The earlier nullable-tree assertion is exact for its own schema but only a related component of the retained Tree/Meta witness; equality syntax alone is not an exact Check.

Reviewer B proposes relocating the nullable union while keeping the earlier valid-tree oracle. This is retained as an unexecuted smaller alternative. Without P/R execution it does not establish that structured Meta constraints can be omitted from the selected failure.

The recursive-array and separate property-reference fragments were really executed, but no complete composed schema/data configuration was. Compatibility and source-unit counts describe a proposal, not a validated witness.
